issue.title: test_reset_to_auto_matches_fresh_decision times out in wait_for under a loaded full suite

task_type_fields.evidence: Reported by sase-1q4.2 note #3 (epic sase-1q4, vocab phase, 2026-10-30): under the loaded full-suite lane of sase tool run check 36a999e251b12a4bd9998cd06b24f614 the pilot test failed with a wait_for timeout; rerun in isolation on the unchanged tree it passed. 1 failure observed, parallel-only; serial isolation passes. The vocab phase did not touch deck-view code.

issue.creation_reason: Filed by the sase-1q4 land agent from sase-1q4.2's PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: a deck-view pilot test hit a wait_for timeout under load and passed in isolation on the same tree.

payload.entry: Backlog triage (2026-11-27), verified on master 6b58ad0fe2: The failure was a sase.ace.testing.wait_for timeout (then 5 s default) under load. 4a7ce0f330 (2026-11-07) made DEFAULT_WAIT_TIMEOUT 60 s as a hang detector in src/sase/ace/testing/wait.py, and settle_view (tests/ace/tui/widgets/decks/_deck_view_main_support.py:97) uses that default. The test moved to _deck_view_main_policy_tests.py (5ce5edfd88) and has 0 failures in 489 local full runs since 11-08.
